provenance.layer: 1 - patient data acquisition for patient-specific organ dose
provenance.archive: The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA), public NBIA REST API
provenance.redistribution: No DICOM is redistributed by this repository. Each series is identified by its Series Instance UID, collection and licence so that a reader retrieves it from the archive directly; see docs/REPRODUCING_DATA.md.

parameters.data_use_note: TCIA data are subject to the TCIA Data Usage Policy and to each collection's own licence. The per-series licence recorded here must be reproduced in any publication, together with the collection name and the retrieval date. No imaging is redistributed by this repository.
